name: Set Up Institutional User Accounts
description: Create three new user accounts in the SEB Server web interface with specific roles for a computer science department. Navigate to 'User Account' in the left sidebar. Create the following accounts: (1) Username 'prof.martinez', name 'Elena Martinez', email 'elena.martinez@university.edu', with role 'Exam Administrator'. (2) Username 'ta.chen', name 'Wei Chen', email 'wei.chen@university.edu', with role 'Exam Supporter'. (3) Username 'admin.thompson', name 'James Thompson', email 'james.thompson@university.edu', with role 'Institutional Administrator'. For all accounts, set the password to 'SecurePass2024!' and set the timezone to 'UTC'. Make sure all three accounts are active by clicking 'Activate User Account' before saving. The SEB Server is accessible at http://localhost:8080 with login credentials super-admin / admin.
